Nina: quick sync - we're doing an emergency base-image rebuild window to address the libc advisory. plan: ephemeral KMS signer, tightly scoped RBAC, and immutable audit trail.
Omar: timeline? will this touch production keys?
Nina: no prod key changes. we create a short-lived key version and an ephemeral SA just for signing during the window. key lifetime ~3h.
Rae: what roles exactly? want least privilege.
Nina: `roles/cloudkms.cryptoSigner` on specific key version, `roles/logging.logWriter` to the audit project, and `roles/storage.objectCreator` only for the signatures bucket.
Omar: add IAM conditions if possible (request.time < timestamp) and an IP allowlist to reduce blast radius.
Rae: logging: ensure KMS Data Access + Storage Data Access are exported to restricted logs project with 1y retention for now; customers can request longer. Also tag logs with `correlation_id` and `image_build_id`.
Nina: agree. will inject correlation headers through the pipeline and the cosign invocation.
sig-bot: CI: build #4092 produced new base-canary image; awaiting signature.
Nina: cosign command in CI will use `gcpkms://projects/redwood-infra/.../cryptoKeys/cosign` with ephemeral key version.
Omar: alerting: create rules - (1) signer SA usage >4 signs/10m, (2) any AsymmetricSign call from outside our CIDR. notify #eng-sre and #eng-security.
Rae: rollback plan: if signature verification fails, pipeline tags the previous signed image, disables new tag, and triggers a forensics runbook: revoke key version, disable SA, collect logs using correlation_id.
Nina: I've opened PR with IAM bindings + runbook changes. please review.
Omar: security note - image-qa flagged low-severity CVE in a dependency graph. still do rebuild during window, include repro steps in PR.
Rae: post-canary: archive signature artifacts to a WORM bucket for 90 days, then move to cold storage. add manifest attestation to artifact metadata.
Nina: thanks. action items: Omar - alerts + IP allowlist; Rae - sink + retention; Nina - finalize SA + CI integration. sig-bot: mark task done when signature uploaded.
sig-bot: Signature uploaded to gs://image-signatures/wip/4092/sig.json
